sdk_version: 0.26.0 (packages/ui-bridge/package.json at the commit below; unreleased main)
source: UIBridgeRegistry.createSnapshot() — the payload GET /ui-bridge/control/snapshot serves — run under the SDK's own vitest/jsdom config; JSON round-tripped (the bytes that go over HTTP), pretty-printed with 2-space indent
capture_command: cp rust/tests/fixtures/ui_bridge_sdk/capture/wire-fixture.capture.test.ts <ui-bridge>/packages/ui-bridge/src/core/ && cd <ui-bridge>/packages/ui-bridge && WIRE_FIXTURE_OUT=<abs path>/sdk_main_create_snapshot.json npx vitest run src/core/wire-fixture.capture.test.ts
trim: none — the whole createSnapshot() output; timestamp/snapshotId/signature/registeredAt are whatever the run produced
notes: Exercises: an element with customActions (sendKeys, getScrollback) serialized as names, a component with ComponentActionInfo actions (id, label, description, effect), a workflow, and the undoRedo enricher. The harness also registers a paramSchema on the `save` action, but createSnapshot() drops paramSchema from component actions by design (serializeRegisteredComponent, packages/ui-bridge/src/core/registry.ts at the commit above), so it is NOT on this wire; /control/components is the surface that carries it.
